name: Neon capsule and rings
what: A light headline slides in word by word on a dark dot grid while a colour wave runs through its letters; it tilts, spins into a neon outlined capsule that unwinds to level, three thin rings spread out round it, and a second line is typed inside the capsule with a trailing colour wave and a blinking cursor, under a soft glow that sweeps along the top of the frame.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f6-f38 the headline's words fade in one by one while the line scrolls left into place; f20-f45 a colour wave runs through the letters; f47-f55 the line tilts clockwise to 30 degrees; f56 it is replaced by a neon capsule at 1.63x and 41 degrees that unwinds to level and 1.0x by f78 (x0.86 a frame); rings appear at f62, f68 and f74; f83-f108 a second line is typed inside the capsule, cursor blinking from f112; hold to f145

tracks.name: headline in
tracks.what: the words fade in one after another and the line scrolls left into place

tracks.name: colour wave
tracks.what: a colour wave runs left to right through the letters and drains out

tracks.name: capsule unwinds
tracks.what: a neon capsule replaces the line, big and tilted, and unwinds to level and size

tracks.name: rings
tracks.what: three thin rings appear round the capsule, one every 6 frames

tracks.name: typing
